name: Generate Bell state
description: You are given two qubits in state and an integer index . Your task is to create one of the Bell states on them according to the index :
input_specification: You have to implement an operation which takes an array of 2 qubits and an integer as an input and has no output. The "output" of your solution is the state in which it left the input qubits. Your code should have the following signature: namespace Solution { open Microsoft.Quantum.Primitive; open Microsoft.Quantum.Canon; operation Solve (qs : Qubit[], index : Int) : () { body { // your code here } } }
approach_summary: Identify exchange argument or greedy choice property. Sort elements by payoff ratio or deadline and greedily pick candidates to achieve global optimum.
